elements.label: Figure 5.5
elements.description: Line chart of household consumption per capita by household head occupation skill level. Y-axis: "Annual household consumption per capita (VND, millions)", ticks at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100. X-axis: years 2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018, 2020. Legend: High-skilled non-manual (teal), Low-skilled non-manual (orange), Skilled manual (grey), Unskilled (yellow). No values are printed on the chart; approximate readings: High-skilled non-manual ~35, ~46, ~52, ~59, ~67, ~87; Low-skilled non-manual ~23, ~29, ~35, ~43, ~51, ~60; Skilled manual ~16, ~21, ~25, ~30, ~36, ~42; Unskilled ~11, ~16, ~20, ~24, ~28, ~33 (for 2010 through 2020 in order). Note: Household consumption in annual per capita nominal VND. Source: World Bank staff calculations using VHLSS 2010-2020. All four series rise over the period, with high-skilled non-manual households consistently highest and showing the steepest rise after 2018, and unskilled households consistently lowest.
